title: Task sync slice 1: typed deterministic task text format with round-trip export and import between two isolated stores
outcome: Task sync slice 1: typed deterministic task text format with round-trip export and import between two isolated stores
acceptance: Exporting a store's shared task state and importing it into a second isolated store round-trips every exported record with stable UUIDs (ids never re-minted or rewritten)
Export is deterministic: the same store state exports byte-identical text, proven by a repeat-export test
Import is atomic and idempotent: a failed or partial import leaves the target store untouched, and importing the same export twice changes nothing the second time, with tests
No live claims, grants, delivery state or private (agent-scope) scratch is ever exported, proven by a test that seeds each kind and inspects the exported text
No durable-store migration and no TermAl remote relay are introduced in this slice

completion.summary: Delivered typed deterministic planning-text directory export and atomic import with stable UUID round trips, exact-repeat no-op, rollback-safe dry run, inert reported history and private/live-state exclusion.
